_about: The only statements a brief may make about iTmethods products. Source: public itmethods.com pages re-fetched 2026-09-24 23:22 KST. See itmethods-product-facts.md. Register row A-029.

claims.text: Forge is iTmethods' managed runtime and infrastructure substrate for DevOps, AI workloads and agent runtimes: "Forge runs; Reign governs".
Reign products are sold independently, not as a bundle.
Reign Ops and Reign Gateway are available; Reign Factory is in beta; Reign Assurance is in co-design.
Reign Gateway is a governed path for agent and application calls to approved models and tools, with identity, policy, spend limits, and records of caller, decision, destination and outcome.
Reign Assurance is being designed to prepare evidence; the people who own the risk decide. It does not issue an audit opinion or a certification.
The Executive Assurance Briefing is the first stage (Briefing, then Runtime Risk and Governance Assessment, Focused Pilot, Platform Rollout) and is aimed at boards, audit and risk committees.
For banks, iTmethods works as first line on OSFI E-23, SR 26-2 and DORA readiness; it does no independent validation.
